parameters.content:
## Weekly sitemap check

Check a bounded sitemap sample for noindex URLs, redirects, HTTP errors, and canonical mismatches. Returns one JSON summary per run and shows fetch errors separately from page findings.

1. In the HTTP Request node, add a Header Auth credential with name `Authorization` and value `Bearer <your Apify API token>`. Store it only in Credentials.

2. Run the 10-URL demo once. Replace `sites` in the request body with a site you maintain or are authorized to audit. The workflow respects robots.txt.

3. Inspect the summary. If you want repeat runs, set your workflow time zone, enable the disabled weekly trigger, and publish. Add storage or alerts if you want them; nothing is sent there by default.

The request asks Apify to cap Actor charges at US$0.25 per run. [Actor and current pricing](https://apify.com/axiorasolutions/sitemap-seo-audit). This Actor is published by Axiora Solutions, the template author.
